hook.name: TaxLaunchHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for token launchpad pools that gates pool creation to a factory, blocks external liquidity, and collects configurable multi-recipient tax fees (burn, protocol, creator, integrator, dividend) on each swap. Supports an optional anti-snipe surcharge during a configurable time window after launch, during which exact-output swaps are blocked.
